items.title: Henry "Pickle" Jackson Interview, 1961-08-09
items.q: I never got to hear him. I never got to meet him.

ctx.x: What did the band sound like? What's the type of band?

P-Rone had more of a concert band. His band was more of a soft music style. Like you hear those guys say, Guy Lombard, the Swedish music this side ever. P-Rone had one of the bands with the Swedish music this side ever. He had one of the bands with the Swedish music this side ever. P-Rone had one of the bands with the Swedish music. He was a violin player. Yes, I never got to hear him. I never got to meet him. He was one of the little cripple fellow, one of the little violin players. His band never was no hot…
